name: PagerDuty escalation-policy route, pagination, and identity guards
$limitation: This plan covers the provider-owned offset paginator, full-row normalization, and route identity guard. Executor registration, capability/matrix wiring, tombstone reconciliation, and deployment activation remain intentionally outside this provider-only slice.

mutations.rationale: PagerDuty's offset is the number of rows returned, not the configured limit; a wrong advancement repeats or skips source rows and is exposed by the second request URI.
The provider's explicit more=false marker is the only authoritative end-of-snapshot signal; ignoring it causes an unnecessary request and cannot report a complete bounded result.
A missing progress marker is malformed, not an empty successful snapshot; accepting it would erase the distinction between a valid terminal page and an unproven response.
PagerDuty can advertise more pages only when the offset made progress; an empty page with more=true must never spin or be accepted as complete.
Python requires the verified PagerDuty account subdomain for provider_instance_id; falling back to the API host would merge accounts and fork canonical IDs.
